steps.description: Correction plan required to resolve review findings

findings.claim: Existing subdirectories are watched only when traversal reaches them. While an earlier file is being copied or hashed, a concurrent writer can modify and restore a file in a later subdirectory without producing an event on any installed watch. The final inventory then matches the baseline and verification succeeds despite a mutation during the advertised observation window. Install watches throughout the existing hierarchy before beginning the bounded observation claim, and test mutation/restoration in a not-yet-traversed subtree.
proof_refs: skills/requerimientos-socraticos/scripts/requirements_guard.py:109-116 installs directory watches incrementally during depth-first traversal; directory watches do not recursively cover descendants.
skills/requerimientos-socraticos/scripts/requirements_guard.py:130-140 reads earlier files before traversal reaches later directories.
skills/requerimientos-socraticos/tests/test_guard.py:54-60 tests modification/restoration only after explicitly installing the affected directory's watch.
docs/skill-audit/integrity-challenge/red-baseline.json:9 requires rejection of observed mutation-and-restore during the bounded monitored window.
